title: Phone Backup and Restore
summary: Easily backup and restore your data with the Phone Backup and Restore App
description:
Want to create backups of all your important data and applications? Utilize this amazing Phone Backup and Restore app, in which you can easily set the backup of your applications, contacts, and calendars. The Phone Backup and Restore app allows you to set the backup of your data to a storage folder of your choice, or you can restore any data or important application to your selected files. With just a simple touch, you can easily get a backup of your files with the Phone Backup and Restore App.

Phone Backup and Restore with set the path of backup and restore your data, or you can also delete the backup at your convenience when you want. With just a single click, you have the option to backup, share, launch, uninstall, or change the app's information. You can easily search for an app and also set the app's view with its name, size, and date. Backup all contacts in a separate folder, or also set the backup of and calendars to your choice of backup folders.

FEATURES:

Easily get a backup and restore of your data
Set your desired folder for backup and restore
Allows to set backup for apps, contacts, calendars
Simple set and delete backups as per your needs
You can also set the backup data to a local folder
Get instructions on how to backup and restore data
Keep a backup folder to keep your data secure and safe
